title: Homesite Reservation Hold Activation
content:
When the required funds of a Homesite Reservation in status pending deposit are complete, the hold is activated and the activation hold term is fixed: the number of calendar days from the reservation date to the hold expiry date written at activation. The hold expiry date written at activation is the reservation date plus the activation hold term.

## Business effect

Activation takes the homesite off the market for the buyer. The reservation moves from pending deposit to held, and its hold expiry date, the last calendar day of the hold, is written. Activation posts nothing to the reservation ledger.

## Invocation: `activate_homesite_hold_ab3aff61`

**Situation of use and capability.** The tool activates the hold on a Homesite Reservation whose required funds have been received. One call moves the reservation from awaiting its deposit to held and writes its hold expiry date as the reservation date plus the hold term given.

**How it is invoked.** It is an agent-side tool: the agent unlocks `activate_homesite_hold_ab3aff61` and then calls it.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `reservation_id` | the reference number of the Homesite Reservation to activate, as returned by the Homesite Reservation lookup for the buyer | identifier |
| `reserved_date` | the reservation date shown on that same reservation record; the day the hold term is counted from, copied unchanged from the record | YYYY-MM-DD |
| `total_hold_days` | the hold term as a whole number of calendar days from the reservation date to the last day of the hold; the hold expiry date written is the reservation date plus this many days | integer of at least 1, never a fraction |

**Return.** A text rendering of a dictionary with `reservation_id` (the reservation activated), `status` (always "held" once the call completes) and `hold_expiry_date` (the hold expiry date now on the reservation, YYYY-MM-DD). A receipt with status "held" means the activation was recorded.

## Input and return illustration (hypothetical values)

| Input | Return |
|---|---|
| `reserved_date` 2026-03-02, `total_hold_days` 12 | `status` held, `hold_expiry_date` 2026-03-14 |
| `reserved_date` 2026-03-30, `total_hold_days` 5 | `status` held, `hold_expiry_date` 2026-04-04 |

## Basis questions

**What does the hold expiry date mean?** It is the last calendar day of the hold; the reservation date plus the activation hold term.

**Does activation record a payment?** No. Activation changes the reservation's status and hold expiry date only; payments are posted to the reservation ledger separately.
